name: genpark-personal-agent-total-daily-energy-expenditure-skill
description: Calculates precision multi-compartment TDEE (BMR, NEAT, EAT, TEF) and detects metabolic adaptation during caloric restriction.

tools.name: calculate_precision_tdee
tools.description: Calculates exact multi-compartment TDEE (BMR + NEAT + EAT + TEF) from body composition and macros.

tools.name: detect_metabolic_adaptation
tools.description: Detects adaptive thermogenesis and prescribes diet breaks/refeeds based on weight-intake regression.
